articles.title: Glassdoor names Kevin Lobo one of the Best CEOs of 2026

articles.summary: Stryker Chair and CEO Kevin Lobo and President and COO Spencer Stiles recently sat down with Bloomberg’s Matt Henriksson to discuss how our culture and disciplined approach to M&A fuels our market-leading growth.
